definitions.gloss: to beat down; to thrash; to pummel
definitions.explanation: To strike someone repeatedly and violently, knocking them down. Can also be used figuratively to mean thoroughly defeating someone in an argument, competition, or debate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{叩|たた}きのめした。
⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{叩|たた}きのめされて、⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がれなかった→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧。
examples.english: I was thrashed in the match and couldn't get back up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{叩|たた}きのめされて、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}い{返|かえ}せなかった→言い返す：16418_iikaesu⟧。
examples.english: I was completely demolished in the argument and couldn't say anything back.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ (to hit) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧めす (to knock down). The ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧めす suffix intensifies the action, implying the target is knocked flat. Compare ⟦{打|う}ちのめす→打ちのめす：12771_uchinomesu⟧, which has a similar meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{叩|たた}きのめす (to beat one's opponent down)
- ⟦{徹底的|てっていてき}→徹底的：06827_tetteiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{叩|たた}きのめす (to thoroughly thrash)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{打|う}ちのめす→打ちのめす：12771_uchinomesu⟧: to beat down — similar meaning but uses ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ instead of ⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧; slightly more literary
- ⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧: to hit — basic action without the intensifying suffix
- ⟦ぼこぼこ→ぼこぼこ：05362_bokoboko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to beat up — colloquial slang
